### September 2026

- Am about to start teaching the EBPhD [methods seminar on computational reproducibility](https://methods-seminar-computational-reproducibility-7171ac.pages.uzh.ch/) at the University of Zurich.
- Was on holiday in Slovenia (5--14 Sep), with lots of gravel biking. 🚴
- We uploaded the revised version of our [CORTRE](https://cortre.github.io/index.html) Registered Report (currently pending moderation) and will resubmit it to PCI Registered Report.

### August 2026

- Attended the [MSMR](https://crsuzh.pages.uzh.ch/msmr/) in Zurich (31 Aug -- 1 Sep).
- Was an instructor at the [Meta-Science Summer School](https://www.bihealth.org/en/notices/meta-science-summer-school-designing-and-conducting-studies-to-improve-research-1) near Frankfurt (24 -- 28 Aug).
- We submitted the first milestone of the [INSPECT project](https://crsuzh.pages.uzh.ch/inspect/) (15 Aug).
- Was interviewed for a *Nature* career feature on lotteries in research funding: [When the best decision is no decision: the rise of randomization in grant funding](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-02082-7) (11 Aug).

### July 2026

- Together with my CoARA working group colleagues F. Schönbrodt, K. A. Nawrot and D. Crepaldi, we published a poster and booklet on [The structure and formative dimensions of research excellence](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21670038).
- Our EU WIDERA application, which I coordinated, was not funded. A big bummer, but on to the next one!

### June 2026

- I attended the final iRISE General Assembly in Split (end of June) and the iRISE WP5 Synthesis Event in Nijmegen (beginning of June).
